Oven-Baked Lemon Salmon
Prep time 5 min, bake time 15 min, total 20 min.

2 salmon fillets
1 lemon
1 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp dried dill
salt
pepper

Preheat the oven to 200 °C.
Place the salmon on a lined tray, drizzle with olive oil, season with dill, salt and pepper and top with lemon slices.
Bake for 15 minutes.
